description: This file defines the ReceiveResult activity in an Android application, demonstrating how to receive data from another activity via startActivityForResult and onActivityResult. It manages user interface elements, handles result codes, and coordinates activity interactions.

classes.name: ReceiveResult
classes.description: An Android activity that launches another activity expecting a result back, and updates the UI based on the result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up UI references and click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result returned from the launched activity, updating the TextView with the result or cancellation.
